features: AI HEALTH REPORT: Flex Air's AI creates a complete, easy-to-read health report with an overall score and a section each for steps, sleep, heart rate, calories, stress and HRV. It ends with a clear conclusion and practical suggestions, and even tells you what data is missing so your report keeps getting better.

GOMORE ALGORITHM FOR ACCURATE TRACKING: It runs on the GoMore algorithm, the sports science engine used in premium wearables. It turns every movement into accurate steps, calories and workout data, so your AI health report is built on numbers you can trust.

100+ SPORTS MODES: Track running, walking, cycling, gym, yoga and 100+ more activities from the app. It's water resistant (1 ATM) against sweat, rain and splashes. Remove it before swimming or showering.

ALL-DAY HEALTH TRACKING: This fitness tracker with heart rate monitor tracks heart rate, SpO2 and HRV around the clock, plus stress, sleep and even daytime naps. One-key measurement gives you an instant reading, and period tracking makes it a great fitness tracker for women too.
UP TO 30 DAYS BATTERY: One quick 2-hour magnetic charge lasts 20–30 days (45 days on standby). You can go weeks without a charger, and your tracking never stops.

FEATHERLIGHT WITH SMART ALERTS: It's so light you'll forget you're wearing it. You get alerts for calls, a silent alarm, sitting reminders, camera control, find-my-band and Do Not Disturb. It works with iPhone and Android, and the app is available in 40+ languages, including Hindi.
Black Strap, Size : 27 x 4.3 x 1.38 cm
